About
AI research and products that transform how we interact with technology
We’re backed by leading names
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
Our vision is to make communication and creation with technology seamless. We started by building with the first human-like voice model. Now we’ve expanded well beyond voice.
We build three platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
We provide free licenses to those who need it most through The ElevenLabs Impact program. This includes individuals with accessibility needs and nonprofit organizations across healthcare, education, and culture.
AI safety is inseparable from innovation at ElevenLabs. We have a dedicated safety team combining research, engineering, and policy. We deploy a comprehensive set of safeguards in a multi-layered defense system to prevent, detect, enforce, and inform misuse.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

Overview
This page describes ElevenLabs’ reporting channels, content moderation standards, user notification and redress, points of contact, privacy alignment, and transparency reporting required by the EU Digital Services Act (“
DSA
”).
Reporting Illegal Content
Anyone can notify us of allegedly illegal content using our
online reporting form
. The form is accessible without login and is designed to be easy to use. We review reports in line with our legal obligations. Where required by law, we may notify competent authorities.
Content Moderation Standards
We assess reported content and accounts under applicable law and our contractual terms, including our
Terms of Service
and
Prohibited Use Policy
. We may use automated tools and human review to support moderation.
Notifications and Redress
If we restrict access to content or take action on an account, the affected user will receive a notice stating the reason for the action, the legal or contractual basis, and how to seek redress. Users may submit an internal complaint through their account. Information about out-of-court dispute settlement options will be provided where applicable.
Points of Contact
Authorities point of contact (pursuant to Article 11 of the DSA):
legal@elevenlabs.io
User point of contact (pursuant to Article 12 of the DSA): via our
webform
or via
legal@elevenlabs.io
We accept communications in English.
Privacy and Data Protection
We process personal data related to reports, moderation, and complaints in accordance with GDPR and our
Privacy Policy
, for purposes including compliance with legal obligations and maintaining service integrity. We retain information only as necessary for these purposes and as required by law.
Transparency Reporting
We publish transparency reports in accordance with the requirements of the DSA, including information on content moderation and the average number of monthly active recipients in the EU.
EU Representative

Hotel Europejski Offices, ul. Tokarzewskiego 1/11, 00-071 Warsaw, Poland; and
legal@elevenlabs.io

Frequently asked questions
What are the eligibility requirements?
Monetized product use case: The goal of the ElevenLabs Grants is to help new and nascent products and business models powered by AI voices take off without too much start up cost. As such, only applications with a business or monetization strategy should apply. Only applications with valid business emails will be considered.

No short-term or one-off projects: Grants will only be awarded to companies seeking to build products they intend to take to market for the long term. One-off projects and campaigns will not be considered.

No projects for minors: We are unable to award grants to companies that are building projects for children aged 18 or under.

Startups and small companies only: The ElevenLabs Grants program is open to all startups or companies with less than 25 employees at the time of receiving the application.

No agencies or consulting firms: Agencies and consulting firms are not eligible for an ElevenLabs Grant.

One application per company: Each company can only submit one application. If you have multiple companies (rock on!) you can submit one application for each company. Existing enterprise customers are not eligible for grants.

Terms of receipt: If awarded a Grant, the company must agree to display "ElevenLabs Grants" logo at the bottom of their website, and include a link to the ElevenLabs website for at least twelve (12) months from the date of grant approval.
Is there any specific deadline to apply?
No, applications are considered on a rolling basis.
What happens after the 12 months duration of my grant?
After your grant period is over or once you have 10,000 credits left, your plan will automatically convert to a Free plan, unless you have selected otherwise. If your project goes to the moon, you can also reach out to a team member at sales@elevenlabs.io anytime to help figure out a long term plan for your successful new product. However, not all projects go as planned so if after twelve months, your product doesn't take off, you'll have full flexibility to continue on a Free plan or upgrade to one of our Paid plans.
What happens if I need more text characters?
If you use all your 33M text characters prior to the conclusion of the 12month grant term, your plan will automatically convert to a Free plan, unless you have selected otherwise. You will receive an automatic email notifying you when you are close to hitting the 33M cap. At any time you can also reach out to a team member at sales@elevenlabs.io to help figure out a long term plan for your successful new product.
Can I resell or exchange my grants for cash?
You cannot exchange or resell your text characters. Reselling your text characters would be a violation of the ElevenLabs Grant program conditions and your grant plan will be terminated immediately.
Do you sign NDAs before an application is submitted?
Sorry, we are not able to sign NDAs for Grant applications.

Frequently asked questions
What is the ElevenLabs API?
The ElevenLabs API provides programmatic access to our AI models for voice, music, sound effects, dubbing, and transcription. You can integrate these capabilities directly into your applications, workflows, and production pipelines.
Which APIs are available?
Text to Speech (TTS): Turns text into lifelike audio with nuanced intonation, pacing, and emotional awareness.
Speech to Text (Transcription): Turns spoken audio into text with state-of-the-art accuracy.
Music: Generate music from text.
Studio: Manage ElevenLabs Studio projects via API.
Text to Dialogue: Create natural-sounding dialogue from text.
Voice Changer: Replace one voice with another.
Voice Isolator (Audio Isolation): Isolate vocal tracks from background noise in audio.
Dubbing: Dub audio and videos seamlessly (translate and voice-over content in other languages).
Sound Effects: Create cinematic sound effects from text descriptions.
Voice Design: Create custom AI voices from text prompts when a needed voice isn’t available in the library.
Voice Remixing: Transform and enhance existing voices (remix voice characteristics or style).
Forced Alignment: Align text to audio (get precise word-level timestamps for given audio and transcript).
Pronunciation Dictionaries: Customize how specific words or phrases are pronounced by TTS models (upload lexicon files to control pronunciation).
Audio Native: An embeddable audio player that automatically voices webpage content using ElevenLabs TTS service.
Agents Platform (Voice Agents): Deploy intelligent voice agents for interactive applications. These endpoints support building, launching, and managing AI-driven voice agents (with components like conversations, knowledge bases, phone integration).
What can I build with the API?
Common use cases include content localization pipelines, automated video production, conversational interfaces, accessibility tools, and training content generation. The API is designed for both real-time and batch processing.
How does authentication work?
All API requests require an API key passed in the xi-api-key header. Keys are generated in your account settings and can be scoped to specific workspaces.
What are the usage limits?
Usage limits vary by plan and endpoint. PAYG usage is enabled from our Starter plan and above.
Do you provide SDKs?
Yes. Official SDKs are available for Python & JavaScript/TypeScript, and additional platforms like Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin for our Agents platform.
How is usage metered?
Text to Speech is billed per character. Speech to Text is billed per audio minute. Music and Sound Effects are billed per generation. Dubbing is billed per source audio minute.
Can I use custom voices via API?
Yes. You can reference any voice in your library by ID, including professional voices, cloned voices, and voices you've designed.
Is the API content safe for commercial use?
Yes. Content generated through the API using ElevenLabs models is commercially licensed. Music requires an additional license for advertising, film, TV, games, and enterprise distribution.
What latency should I expect?
Text to Speech typically responds in under 500ms for streaming. Speech to Text processes at 20-50x real-time depending on file size. Dubbing and Music are batch operations with processing times proportional to content length.
Do you support streaming?
Yes. Text to Speech and Speech to Text both support streaming output, allowing you to use the APIs in real-time applications.
How do I handle errors?
The API returns standard HTTP status codes. Rate limit errors return 429. Invalid requests return 400 with error details. Authentication failures return 401.
Where can I find API documentation?
Complete API reference, code examples, and integration guides are available at elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference
Do you offer enterprise support?
Yes. Enterprise plans include dedicated support, SLAs, custom rate limits, SSO, SOC 2 compliance, and MSAs.

What content can I import into the app?
You can upload files like ePubs and PDFs, import articles via links, scan content from images, or even copy and paste text directly into the app.
Can I export audio from the app?

Is the app free?

Which languages does the app support?
The app lets you listen to text content voiced in
32 languages
today. Currently, the app is localized for 8 languages and includes popular listening content in English-only. We plan to localize the app into additional languages to continue supporting our users around the world soon.
What voices are available in the app?

FAQ
How high quality does my data need to be?
We don’t have minimum requirements. Voices should be crisp and understandable, and background noise should ideally be no higher than a typical human-to-human conversation. As a reference, anything at or above 44.1kHz sample rate would be considered good quality for us, though for phone calls we can work with as low as 8 kHz.
Can Eleven help me clean and prepare my data?
Yes.
Do I need to provide transcripts as well?
No. But if you have high-quality transcripts already, please submit them along with the audio.
Will my data be shared with anyone else?
No. We want this to be a true partnership and give you 2 options:
We use your data to help our train models to perform better for your domain. This benefits everyone, but nobody has access to your data.
We use your data for something specific to you, e.g. fine tuning.
Is my dataset too small to be interesting?
We don’t have minimum requirements. Even small amounts of data can help us better serve low-resource languages and accents.
I’m not sure about the licenses I have for my data – should I still apply?
Yes! We can help you figure this out.

What is Impact Voice Lab?
People who have lost their ability to speak due to disease are now able to re-create their natural speaking voice through ElevenLabs. Clean, high-quality audio is essential for this process, but not everyone has the tools or skills to make this happen. This page connects volunteers with patients to create clear audio recordings and ensure every voice is heard.
Volunteer as an Audio Editor
Make a meaningful impact by helping people preserve their voices. As a volunteer audio editor, you’ll assist in cleaning up audio recordings, removing background noise, and improving clarity. Often what people have left of their voices are voice mails, wedding videos, or archival recordings. They’re not studio-quality files, so we need to be flexible and creative for the sake of the patients who, with the help of the Audio Editor, will regain their comfort in life.

Frequently asked questions
What local deployment options are available?
We offer two deployment paths: on-premise for GPU-enabled servers, and on-device for edge and embedded environments with constrained compute and memory.
Does any data leave my environment?
No. All inference and data processing run entirely within your infrastructure. License validation and telemetry are optional and configurable, including fully air-gapped setups.
Which model versions are available?
Our on-premise and on-device models are built specifically for these environments. They do not mirror the full cloud portfolio, but they reflect our highest quality standards. Updates are delivered on a controlled cadence aligned with enterprise needs for stability and long-term support.
Can models be fine-tuned or customized?
Yes. We support fine-tuning for specific languages or dialects. Deeper customization is also available - contact us to discuss your requirements.
What are the hardware requirements?
On-premise deployments run on standard GPU-enabled servers. On-device deployments are optimized for entry-level GPUs, NPUs, and modern CPU and ARM-based chips. Contact us for detailed specifications.
How is pricing structured?
Pricing is defined case by case to reflect differences in deployment environments and use cases. It typically includes a license fee and a usage-based component. Contact sales for a custom quote.
When will local deployments be available?
We expect initial on-premise and on-device releases in the first half of 2026.
